mechanism: Prochlorperazine may reduce gastrointestinal iron absorption through anticholinergic effects and gastric pH alterations, while ferrous sulfate can cause GI upset that may be worsened by prochlorperazine's antiemetic paradoxically masking tolerability issues.
action: Monitor for reduced iron efficacy; consider separating administration times or monitoring hemoglobin levels more frequently; prochlorperazine's antiemetic benefit may still justify concurrent use with clinical oversight.
